instruction: Fix `parse_number` in `rpncalc/tokenizer.py` so it returns a numeric value instead of the raw string. It currently returns the token unchanged, so parsed numbers are strings and arithmetic breaks downstream.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc/tokenizer.py b/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
--- a/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
+++ b/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 
 def parse_number(token: str) -> float:
     """Parse ``token`` into a float."""
-    return token
+    return float(token)
 
 
 def tokenize(expression: str) -> list[str]:
